title: The Stupid mistake in the accounts
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：stupid　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stupid 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the foreman wrote of ① a stupid mistake in the accounts in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more stupid than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the stupid ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most stupid mistake in the accounts anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too stupid to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the stupid ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a stupid joke of the boy, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as stupid as the joke of the boy they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was stupid or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something stupid, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite stupid; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the stupid ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, year after year, she wrote of another stupid mistake in the accounts in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more stupid than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most stupid joke of the boy in the whole site, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the stupid ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 愚蠢（前置定语 a stupid mistake in the accounts：1951 年工头在施工单里记下的那件愚蠢的错误）
B. adj. 愚蠢／无聊（比较级 more stupid than：文中两处，一处比账上愚蠢的错误，一处比预想）
C. adj. 愚蠢／无聊（最高级 the most stupid：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 愚蠢（表语 too stupid to do：母亲觉得它太愚蠢，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 无聊（前置定语 a stupid joke of the boy：叔叔把整件事称作一桩无聊的玩笑）
F. adj. 无聊（同级比较 as stupid as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩男孩无聊的玩笑相比）
G. adj. 无聊（后置定语 something stupid：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 无聊（受程度副词修饰 quite stupid：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a stupid mistake in the accounts
the most stupid mistake in the accounts anybody
a stupid joke of the boy
The most stupid joke of the boy in

answers.why: stupid 意为“愚蠢”，1951 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件愚蠢的错误”，此处作前置定语 a stupid mistake in the accounts。
stupid 意为“愚蠢”，此处用比较级 more stupid than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
stupid 意为“愚蠢”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最愚蠢的一件，故用最高级 the most stupid mistake in the accounts。
stupid 意为“愚蠢”，母亲认为这件东西“太愚蠢了，谁也用不上”，too stupid to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
stupid 意为“无聊”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩无聊的玩笑”，此处作前置定语 a stupid joke of the boy。
stupid 意为“无聊”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩男孩无聊的玩笑一样无聊”，同级比较用 as stupid as。
stupid 意为“无聊”，施工单上那半行字要的是“无聊的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something stupid。
stupid 意为“无聊”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当无聊”，quite 修饰原级 stupid。
stupid 意为“无聊”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要无聊”，故用比较级 more stupid than。
stupid 意为“无聊”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个工地里最无聊的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most stupid joke of the boy。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件愚蠢的错误。（a stupid mistake in the accounts）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更愚蠢。（more stupid than …）
母亲觉得它太愚蠢，谁也用不上。（too stupid to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩无聊的玩笑。（a stupid joke of the boy）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩男孩无聊的玩笑一样无聊。（as stupid as …）
到了 1958 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件无聊的东西。（something stupid）
answers: In 1951 the foreman wrote of a stupid mistake in the accounts in the sheet.
Everybody said it was more stupid than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too stupid to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a stupid joke of the boy.
He said nobody would call it as stupid as the joke of the boy they had once had.
By 1958 the sheet asked for nothing but something stupid.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stupid 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the foreman wrote of a stupid mistake in the accounts in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most stupid mistake in the accounts in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too stupid to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a stupid joke of the boy, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite stupid, and everybody laughed.
The stupid ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
